post.description: Create an account, sign in, and email a link to confirm the address.
End the current session. Succeeds even if not signed in.

delete.description: Permanently delete the account and every video and analysis in it.

post.description:
Confirm an address from the emailed link. Works without signing in, since the
link may be opened on another device.
Email a fresh confirmation link. Earlier links stop working.

Email a reset link if the address has an account. The response is the same
either way, so it can't be used to find out who has an account.
Set a new password from the emailed link. Signs out every device, this one included.

Change the password from Settings. This device stays signed in; every other one is
signed out, and any reset link stops working.

Email a confirmation link to the new address. The account keeps its current
address until the link is opened.

Switch to the new address from the emailed link, and tell the old address.
Works without signing in, like confirming an email.

get.description: Download everything stored about the account, as one JSON file.

patch.description: Change the fields sent; leave the rest as they are.

get.description: Whether a username could be yours, for checking as it's typed.

put.description: A new profile picture: a square JPEG of up to 1 MB, as the browser prepares it.

get.description: Someone's page: what they show you, and where the two of you stand.

post.description: Send a friend request. If they'd already asked you, you're friends straight away.

get.description: Friend requests waiting for you, for the navigation's badge.

post.description: Accept a request someone sent you.

delete.description: Cancel a request you sent, decline one you received, or end a friendship.

get.description:
You and your friends who chose to be on it, ranked by the average of each one's latest
serves in the window. Too few serves in the window means not ranked yet.

post.description: Block someone. Any request or friendship between you ends, and they can't find you.
Create a record and return a presigned URL to PUT the video to.

get.description: History, newest first, optionally filtered. Score filters only match scored analyses.

delete.description:
Delete an analysis with its video and results, whatever its status.

If a worker is processing it, the worker finds the job gone and stops: its
status writes no longer match a row, and anything it publishes is removed.

post.description: Queue the analysis once the upload has finished.

put.description: Add, change or (with an empty note) remove your own note on an analysis.
Tell us this result looks wrong. Sending another replaces the previous report.

get.description: The report sent about this analysis, or null.

schema.title: Response Get Report Analyses  Analysis Id  Report Get

get.description:
Per-frame landmarks and metric series.

Served straight from the pipeline's frames.json (validated against
FramesPayload in tests) to avoid re-parsing a large payload per request.

Only the fields sent are changed. An empty display name or bio removes it; a username,
once chosen, can be changed but not removed.
